_metadata.note: Authoritative licence and identity evidence for the GRID3 source, captured from the publisher's own metadata service rather than relied on from a prior note. Verbatim quotations are marked; everything else states where it was read. The tie between the committed CSV and the published dataset is established by count, field-list, snapshot-date and record-level identity checks recorded below, each reproducible without credentials.

source_file.column_note: The 21 attribute fields of the published layer, plus x and y — the geometry columns ArcGIS Hub appends to a CSV export. The filename's trailing digits are the Hub export job identifier.

exact_file_verification.conclusion: The committed CSV is an ArcGIS Hub CSV export of the published GRID3 NGA - Health Facilities v2.0 layer: identical record count, identical attribute schema and order, identical constant snapshot date, and record-level value identity on the published stable identifier. No byte-level upstream artifact exists to hash-compare (the Hub generates exports on demand), so identity rests on these checks; they are reproducible at the URLs above.
exact_file_verification.superseded_note: The v1.0 metadata's source URL (data.grid3.org/datasets/GRID3::grid3-nga-health-facilities-/explore) now returns 404 — that page described the superseded v1 dataset. The landing page above is the current v2.0 page; the publisher has since also released a v3.0, which this repository does not hold and this record does not cover.

coverage.note: All 36 states plus the FCT have rows, including the three states absent from the NHFR-derived export: Adamawa (1,561), Kebbi (1,207), Sokoto (937). The source spells the capital territory 'Fct'; normalization maps it to 'FCT'.
